verdict.rationale: OpenCode documents itself as an AI coding agent that can fix issues and implement features, including opening PRs from GitHub, and it loads LSPs for the model. That supports general code-editing work but does not specifically cover the four named tasks. missing for 10: documented test-writing workflows, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency-update support, and independent hands-on corroboration of these tasks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent.
Ask OpenCode to fix an issue or implement a feature. And it will work in a new branch and submits a PR with all the changes.
Automatically loads the right LSPs for the LLM
